etymologies.etymologyHTML: From copy +‎ right.

definitions.definition: (uncountable) The right by law to be the entity which determines who may publish, copy and distribute a piece of writing, music, picture or other work of authorship.
(countable) Such an exclusive right as it pertains to one or more specific works.
(uncountable, informal, nonstandard) A violation of copyright law; copyright infringement.

quote.citation: 2019 October 23, Christine Fisher, “House passes controversial copyright bill that could be abused by trolls”, in Engadget‎[1]:
quote.text: Anyone accused of copyright would have sixty days to opt-out of the Copyright Claims Board process, in which case the plaintiff would have to seek legal action in court.

definitions.definition: (transitive, intransitive) To obtain or secure a copyright for some literary or other artistic work.
